[element-glyph-ref]
=== `<glyph-ref>` Glyph Reference For a Private Character

Once a private character has been declared using a <<element-glyph-data,`<glyph-data>`>> element, the character need not be defined with the same <<element-glyph-data,`<glyph-data>`>> element every time it is used. The character can be reused by using the <<element-glyph-ref,`<glyph-ref>`>> element to point to the full <<element-glyph-data,`<glyph-data>`>> element. The pointing uses the `ID/IDREF` linking mechanism, with the <<attribute-glyph-data,`@glyph-data`>> attribute of the <<element-glyph-ref,`<glyph-ref>`>> element pointing to the <<attribute-id,`@id`>> attribute of an existing <<element-glyph-data,`<glyph-data>`>> element. Since the reference uses the `ID/IDREF`, the reference may precede or follow the element to which it is pointing.

#### Attributes

* <<attribute-glyph-data,`@glyph-data`>>
#### Base Attributes

* <<attribute-id,`@id`>>
* <<attribute-xml-base,`@xml:base`>>

#### Models and Context

#### May be contained in

<<element-private-char,`<private-char>`>>
#### Description

This is an EMPTY element
#### Content Model

[source,xml]
....
<!ELEMENT  glyph-ref    EMPTY                                        >
....
